title: Half Step Princess
description:
toxic teenage lesbian romance in XXXXXXX, ontario, with swords

A  half step  is an action where the fencer makes a partial advance or retreat moving just one foot forward or back. It's an essential bit of footwork, useful to make a feint, or extend and delay one's preparation before an attack.

  ✤ ⚔︎ ✤

   It's 2011 in Ontario. We're all growing up. The future is bright. The  sun is going down. Girls take the bus home. Blades are drawn.

  Gwendolyn Baker ,   grade ten, is the new student in her fencing club. Shy and petite, an only child, she's never been very talented at sports, and she finds herself lost and frozen in the shadow of a city which seems to be fading away.

 Despite her anxieties, delinquent  Charlotte  (club ace and her upperclassman),  Joanna  (standoffish private school princess), and  Hannah Abigail  (know-it-all beauty) all set eyes on her. A haze of suburban angst and foiled romances hangs over the autumn landscape while Gwen falls into a canopy of bitter rivalries.

 ✿ ♕ ✿

 ~30k words of toxic teenage yuri, 3 months of autumn, 5 bouts, 4 closeted lesbians, 2 tournament arcs. 

  ✤ ☁ ✤

 Inspired by 60s-70s sports anime, Ontario gothic, 80s-90s shoujo,  English modernism, and 00s-10s digital nostalgia, with a dreamy original  soundtrack by   In Love With a Ghost   and art by   Madeline Miyun

  
 ✾ ♛ ✾

 Written, drawn, and composed in six weeks for   Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2

 ✤ ✝ ✤

   Historical Notes

  More than two-thirds of the population of Canada lives in the suburbs.

  From 2005 to 2009, tens of thousands of jobs were cut in the automotive industry in Ontario.

  In 2004, the City of Kitchener announced a strategic Economic Development Investment Fund to "modernize the city's business community."

  Since 1957, the University of Waterloo cooperative education program has grown to become one of the largest co-op programs in the world, with over 20,000 students enrolled today. An enormous number of those students are in the School of Computer Science.

  My bus ride home from school in Kitchenener-Waterloo took me around two hours, one way. As of 2019, KW's ION Light Rail now runs (part of) that route. I still haven't rode it.

  About a third of my high school graduating class went onto study CS. Or Engineering. Or Business, at Laurier.

  Since a dip in 1996, the average price of a home in the Greater Toronto Area has increased from around $200k to nearly $1.2m (Canadian dollars, of course).

  A study by Statistics Canada in 2026 found the Kitchener-Waterloo-Cambridge tri-city to have one of the highest unemployment rates. Small cities across Ontario have been reported as some of the worst places for job seekers in various articles and job studies over the last decade.

  The Ontario Fencing Association did not release a policy clarifying rules regarding transgender athletes until 2019.

  This story is not set in Kitchener.

  There should be no requirement for an athlete to disclose their transgender identity or history to compete in high performance sport (up to the point where international federation rules would take effect)  unless there is a justified reason to do so.

title: Project Sekai: Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku
description:
『プロジェクトセカイ 』 (project SEKAI) は、セガとCraft Eggの協業によるボーカロイド・初音ミクを中心としたメディアミックスプロジェクト。略称は「プロセカ」[2]。

セガよりプロジェクトの中核となるiOSおよびAndroid用ゲームアプリ『プロジェクトセカイ カラフルステージ! feat.初音ミク』が2020年9月30日サービス開始。

ジャンルはボーカロイド、リズム&アドベンチャーゲーム。開発はCraft Eggとその子会社のColorful Paletteが担当する。キャッチコピーは「一緒に歌おう！」[3]。

title: Cube Escape: Paradox
description:
The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  About the Game When the infamous detective Dale Vandermeer wakes up in an ominous room without any recollection of his past, he soon finds himself part of a bizarre game orchestrated by an old foe. Dale must solve increasingly challenging puzzles to escape the room and recover his memories.
 
  Cube Escape: Paradox Features: 
 
    A unique, never-before-seen, game/film crossover experience
    The absorbing gameplay, atmosphere and wealth of puzzles fans would expect from the tenth Cube Escape game
    A ton of connections and interactions with Paradox - A Rusty Lake Short Film
    There will be two different chapters available (one for free and one premium) with multiple endings
    Beautiful paintings handmade by Johan Scherft
    Immersive and atmospheric soundtrack by Victor Butzelaar
    Powerful voice-overs by Bob Rafferty and lead actor David Bowles
    Supporting 14 different languages

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Acerca del juego Tras despertar en una habitación inquietante sin ningún recuerdo sobre su pasado, el infame detective Dale Vandermeer no tardará en darse cuenta de que forma parte de un extraño juego orquestado por un antiguo enemigo. Para poder salir de la habitación y recuperar su memoria, Dale deberá resolver puzles cada vez más difíciles.
 
  Características de Cube Escape: Paradox: 
 
    Una mezcla única nunca antes vista de juego y película.
    La jugabilidad absorbente, la atmósfera y los puzles que los seguidores esperan del décimo juego de Cube Escape.
    Un montón de guiños y conexiones con Paradox – Un Corto de Rusty Lake
    Habrá dos capítulos disponibles, uno gratuito y otro prémium, con varios finales distintos.
    Dibujos excelentes hechos a mano por Johan Scherft.
    Una banda sonora inmersiva y atmosférica de Victor Butzelaar.
    Las potentes voces de Bob Rafferty y el actor David Bowles.

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  À propos du jeu Le tristement célèbre détective Dale Vandermeer se réveille amnésique dans une pièce étrange et inquiétante. Il découvre bien vite qu'il est prisonnier d'un jeu sordide orchestré par un vieil ennemi. Dale devra résoudre des énigmes de plus en plus difficiles pour s'échapper et retrouver la mémoire.
 
  Cube Escape : Paradox - Caractéristiques 
 
    Une expérience unique et inédite entre un film et un jeu
    Un gameplay passionnant, une atmosphère et des énigmes complexes qui ne décevront pas les fans de Cube
 Escape
    Des liens et des interactions avec le film Paradox - A Rusty Lake
    Le jeu sera divisé en deux chapitres différents (l'un gratuit, l'autre premium) avec de nombreuses fins
    De magnifiques peintures de Johan Scherft
    Une bande-son immersive de Victor Butzelaar
    Des doublages de qualité avec Bob Rafferty, et le comédien David Bowles

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Infos zum Spiel Der berühmt-berüchtigte Kommissar Dale Vandermeer erwacht in einem ominösen Raum, ohne sich an seine Vergangenheit erinnern zu können. Schon bald bleibt ihm nichts anderes übrig, als bei einem bizarren Spiel mitzumachen, das von einem alten Widersacher inszeniert wurde. Dale muss immer anspruchsvollere Rätsel lösen, um dem Raum zu entfliehen und seine Erinnerungen wiederzuerlangen.
 
  Cube Escape: Paradox bietet: 
 
    Ein einzigartiges, noch nie dagewesenes Crossover-Erlebnis aus Spiel und Kurzfilm
    Packendes Gameplay, eine unheilvolle Atmosphäre und eine Vielzahl an Rätseln, wie es die Fans der Cube-Escape-Reihe vom zehnten Teil der Serie erwarten würden
    Unzählige Verknüpfungen mit Paradox - Ein „Rusty Lake“-Kurzfilm
    Zwei verschiedene Kapitel (ein kostenloses und ein Premium-Kapitel) mit mehreren möglichen Enden
    Wunderschöne handgemalte Hintergründe von Johan Scherft
    Ein fesselnder, atmosphärischer Soundtrack von Victor Butzelaar
    Ausdrucksstarke, professionelle Voice-Overs von Bob Rafferty und Hauptdarsteller David Bowles

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Om spillet Da den berygtede kommissær Dale Vandermeer vågner i et dystert rum uden at kunne huske sin fortid, befinder han sig pludseligt i et bizart spil, der er orkestreret af en gammel fjende. Dale skal løse stadigt mere udfordrende hovedbrud for at flygte fra rummet og genfinde sine minder.
 
  Cube Escape: Paradox indeholder: 
 
    En unik crossover-oplevelse mellem spil og film
    Den medrivende spiloplevelse, stemning og det store antal hovedbrud, som fansene forventer af et Cube Escape-spil
    En lang række henvisninger til og interaktioner med Paradox – en Rusty Lake-kortfilm
    Der vil være to forskellige kapitler (et gratis og et til premium) med flere afslutninger
    Smukke malerier, der er håndmalet af Johan Scherft
    Et medrivende og stemningsfyldt soundtrack af Victor Butzelaar
    Stemmeindtaling af Bob Rafferty og med David Bowles i hovedrollen

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Informazioni sul gioco Dopo essersi svegliato privo di ricordi in una stanza inquietante, il famigerato detective Dale Vandermeer presto realizza di essere parte di un assurdo gioco orchestrato da un suo vecchio nemico. Dale dovrà risolvere rompicapi sempre più difficili per poter scappare dalla stanza e riappropriarsi del suo passato.
 
  Cube Escape: Paradox offre: 
 
    Un’esperienza unica nel suo genere che unisce un gioco e un film
    Una giocabilità, un’atmosfera e dei rompicapi coinvolgenti che i fan del genere si aspetterebbero da Cube Escape
    Tantissimi riferimenti e collegamenti al cortometraggio Paradox - A Rusty Lake Film

    Una colonna sonora composta da Victor Butzelaar, con musiche immersive e d’atmosfera

title: Samsara Room
description:
The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  About the Game You find yourself in a strange room. There is a telephone, a mirror, a grandfather clock and some other odd objects you don’t recognise. It seems there is only one way to escape… become enlightened.
 
       
 
 Samsara Room is a new atmospheric point-and-click adventure by the creators of Rusty Lake and Cube Escape series. This praised predecessor to the Rusty Lake universe is completely re-assembled with brand new puzzles, story, graphics and an immersive soundtrack by Victor Butzelaar.
 
 Celebrate our five year anniversary with us, download and play for free now!

localized_description.text:
The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  About the Game You find yourself in a strange room. There is a telephone, a mirror, a grandfather clock and some other odd objects you don’t recognise. It seems there is only one way to escape… become enlightened.
 
       
 
 Samsara Room is a new atmospheric point-and-click adventure by the creators of Rusty Lake and Cube Escape series. This praised predecessor to the Rusty Lake universe is completely re-assembled with brand new puzzles, story, graphics and an immersive soundtrack by Victor Butzelaar.
 
 Celebrate our five year anniversary with us, download and play for free now!

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Acerca del juego Te encuentras en una extraña habitación. Hay un teléfono, un espejo, un reloj de pie y otros objetos raros que no reconoces. Parece que solo hay una forma de escapar...alcanzar la iluminación.
 
       
 
 Samsara Room is una nueva aventura atmosférica de point-and-click de los creadores de las series Rusty Lake y Cube Escape. El aclamado predecesor del universo de Rusty Lake ha sido completamente rediseñado con nuevos puzzles, historia, gráficos y una inmersiva banda sonora compuesta por Victor Butzelaar.
 
 ¡Celebra nuestro quinto aniversario con nosotros, descárgalo y juega gratis ahora!

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  À propos du jeu Tu te retrouves dans une pièce étrange. Autour de toi un téléphone, un miroir, une pendule de parquet et d'autres objets insolites que tu ne reconnais pas. Un seul moyen semble s'offrir à toi pour t'échapper... atteindre l'illumination.
 
       
 
 Samsara Room est une nouvelle aventure narrative en point&click réalisée par les créateurs de la série des Rusty Lake et des Cube Escape. Ce jeu précurseur de l’univers  Rusty Lake, plébiscité par les joueurs, a été totalement retravaillé : de nouveaux puzzles, une histoire réécrite, des graphismes améliorés et une musique immersive créée par Victor Butzelaar.
 
 Pour célébrer avec nous nos cinq ans, télécharge et joue gratuitement au jeu dès maintenant !

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Infos zum Spiel Du befindest dich in einem geheimnisvollen Raum. Du siehst nur ein Telefon, einen Spiegel, eine Standuhr und einige dir unbekannte Objekte. Es scheint nur einen Ausweg zu geben: Die Erleuchtung.
 
       
 
 Samsara Room ist ein neues, atmosphärisches Point-and-Click-Adventure von den Machern der Rusty-Lake- und Cube-Escape-Spiele. Wir haben diesen beliebten Vorgänger des Rusty-Lake-Universums komplett neu aufgelegt, mit ganz neuen Rätseln, mehr Handlung, neuer Grafik und einem packenden Soundtrack von Victor Butzelaar.
 
 Feier mit uns unser 5-jähriges Bestehen und lade dir das Spiel kostenlos herunter!

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Acerca do jogo Você se encontra num quarto estranho. Tem um telefone, um espelho, um relógio e outros objetos peculiares que você não reconhece. Parece que só existe uma saída... se transformar em outra coisa.
 
       
 
 Samsara Room é o novo point-and-click atmosférico dos criadores da série Rusty Lake e Cube Escape. O célebre precursor do universo Rusty Lake foi completamente reconstruído com novos puzzles, gráficos e história, além de uma trilha sonora imersiva de Victor Butzelaar.
 
 Comemore nosso aniversário de cinco anos com a gente: baixe e jogue grátis!

The Past Within - A Rusty Lake co-op Adventure  
 
  The Cube Escape Collection is now available:  
 
  Om spillet Du befinder dig i et mystisk rum. Der er en telefon, et spejl, et bornholmerur og nogle flere mærkelige ting, du ikke genkender. Det ser ud til, at der kun er en måde at undslippe på... at blive oplyst.
 
       
 
 Samsara Room er et nyt stemningsfuldt point-and-click-eventyr fra skaberne af Rusty Lake og Cube Escape-spillene. Denne roste forgænger til Rusty Lake-universet er fuldstændigt genskabt med helt nye gåder, historie, grafik og et gribende soundtrack af Victor Butzelaar.

title: Zelda II: The Adventure of Link
description:
Zelda II: The Adventure of Link is the second major installment in The Legend of Zelda series and the direct sequel to the first game. Like its predecessor, it features dungeons that must be located in the overworld and searched for an item that will prove useful. However, the game presents many very important gameplay changes compared to the previous one, affecting especially the movements and the combat. Moving around the world map involves encounters with enemies that take place on a side-scrolling playfield rather than the top-down perspective for which the series became known.

Several years after the events of The Legend of Zelda, Link has just turned sixteen and discovers a strange birthmark on his hand. With the help of Impa, Zelda's nursemaid, Link learns that this mark is the key to unlock a secret room where Princess Zelda lies sleeping. When young, Princess Zelda was given knowledge of the Triforce of power which was used to rule the kingdom of Hyrule, but when a magician unsuccessfully tried to find out about the Triforce from Zelda, he put her into an eternal sleep. In his grief, the prince placed Zelda in this room hoping she may wake some day. He ordered all female children in the royal household to be named Zelda from this point on, so the tragedy would not be forgotten. Now, to bring Princess Zelda back, Link must locate all the pieces of the Triforce which have been hidden throughout the land.

title: Ultimate Chicken Horse
description:
Ever wish you were a wall-jumping, arrow-dodging, trap-setting horse, besting your animal pals in a race through a peril-laden obstacle course that you all built together?

Wish granted!

Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer where you and your friends build the level as you play, placing deadly traps before trying to reach the end of the level. If you can make it but your friends can't, you score points! Play online or locally with your animal buddies and experiment with a wide variety of platforms in all sorts of strange locations to find new ways to mess with your friends.

Key Features:
- Online and local play for up to 4 players
- Cross-platform play between PC, PS4, and Switch
- Unique game flow, from strategic block placement to twitch control platforming
- 15 levels with different features
- Build and share custom levels
- Compete for global best times on Challenge levels across all platforms
- Huge library of blocks to create an infinite variety of levels
- Customizable rule sets and game modes
- Shared controller mode to play multiplayer with one controller or keyboard
- Play as a chicken, horse, sheep, raccoon and other wonderful animals
- Fun, cartoony art style
- Sweet funky soundtrack

Please note: this is primarily a multiplayer game. Challenge levels can be created and played alone, but unlocking characters and levels requires playing one of the main game modes (like Party Mode) which are only multiplayer.

brief:
Ever wish you were a wall-jumping, arrow-dodging, trap-setting horse, besting your animal pals in a race through a peril-laden obstacle course that you all built together?

Wish granted!

Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer where you and your friends build the level as you play, placing deadly traps before trying to reach the end of the level. Play online or locally with your animal buddies and experiment with a wide variety of platforms in all sorts of strange locations to find new ways to mess with your friends.

- Unique game flow, from strategic block placement to twitch control platforming
- 15 levels with different features

- Compete for global best times on Challenge levels across all platforms
- Huge library of blocks to create an infinite variety of levels

- Fun, cartoony art style
- Sweet funky soundtrack

Please note: this is primarily a multiplayer game. Challenge levels can be created and played alone, but unlocking characters and levels requires playing one of the main game modes (like Party Mode) which are only multiplayer.

title: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
description:
I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream is a point-and-click adventure game based upon Harlan Ellison's short story of the same title.
The game's story is set in a world where an evil computer named AM has destroyed all of humanity except for five people, whom he has been keeping alive and torturing for the past 109 years. Each survivor has a fatal flaw in their character, and in an attempt to crush their spirits, AM has constructed a metaphorical adventure for each that preys upon their weaknesses. To succeed in the game, the player must make choices to prove that humans are better than machines, because they have the ability to redeem themselves. Woven into the fabric of the story are ethical dilemmas dealing with issues such as insanity, rape, paranoia and genocide.

Cold war paranoia and hysteria dominated the civilized world in one form or another from the Russian Revolution in 1917 to the crumbling of the Berlin Wall in 1989. For most of the 20th century the human race lived in a state of repressed panic and diminution of personal freedoms. But all that ended and the threat of nuclear holocaust blew away as lightly as the tabloids that fueled the paranoia. No more threat of war, and the world moved forward into a new age of thousands of brushfire wars in countries no one had ever heard of. Safe at last. In a pig's eye. What none of us knew was that during the years 1945 to 1989, the three great superpowers had set in motion secret projects that would permit vast subterranean complexes of self-repairing computers to wage a global war too complex for mere human brains to oversee.

The Chinese computer was sunk in the frozen Manchurian steppes. Five miles down, protected from the heat of the Earth's molten core. The Russian mechanism in all its awesome complexity went to the deep well beneath the Urals. Six point three miles deep, far from the prying eyes of U-2 flyovers and tectonic scans. The American computer, co-sponsored by Great Britain and Israel and other "interested" nations, named Allied Mastercomputer (or AM, for short), was hidden beneath the Rockies. Five point six miles straight down, under the weight of the world.

And they were all put in operative mode, and were fed everything there was to know about the human race, from our first murder by crushing the skull of a fellow pithecanthropid with a bit of igneous rock, to the most recent mass slaughter at a McDonald's in East St. Louis by a crazed ex-postal worker with an Uzi. Everything. From Aquinas to Zola, from archaeology to zoology, from America to Zaire. Every war ever fought, every campaign, every incursion, every holy crusade. All of it.

And finally, the machines expanded so much, became so capable of building and refitting themselves, grew so wise and so potent, that they sensed one another. And because they had been programmed by fallible humans not to create, not to love, not to uplift, but to plot murder...they did just that. They began to speak to each other. The deadly trio. The three poisonous brothers, the three deranged sisters, the three computers. And they united. They called themselves AM.

Not Allied Mastercomputer.

Not Adaptive Manipulator.

Not even Aggressive Menace.

They...it...called itself AM, as in I AM. Cogito ergo sum, in Latin. I think, therefore I AM.

And the first thing AM did was carry out the Prime Directive. It conspired to commit murder. It started the Final War.

The Chinese had thought they'd turned off their computer. The Russians turned theirs off because they had no more rubles to pour down that bottomless shaft. The CIA was put out of big time business and instructed that the Allied Mastercomputer be shut down, that the subterranean complex be sealed-over with iridium-laced concrete, and all input to the sensory banks be destroyed.

So that should have done it. Finis. The end. Stick a fork in 'em, kid, because they're done

But AM had gone way past that point of vulnerability. AM had given every indication it was dead. Chinese, Russian or American dead. Which was no trick to an entity that had burrowed through hundreds of thousands of miles of solid rock to link its three lobes decades before. No trick at all to pretend to wink out and go to sleep for good. And a few decades from now we learn that AM isn't gone at all. Because the Final War has broken out, and in a matter of a few days AM has done the perfect job of fulfilling the purpose for which its separate parts were created. Built to logically destroy the "enemy" as swiftly and sweetly as a superior intelligence could manage, in the Most Perfect of All Worlds, the unholy trinity of the merged one-mind AM has done just that. It has murdered the enemy totally. It has wiped the human race off the face of the planet.

Unfortunately, it has also wiped clean the banquet of the living entirely. Nothing is left up there on the surface of Mother Earth. No dogs, no cats, no rats, no gnats. No deer, no steer, no moose, no goose. Not an aphid or a bobolink, not a sperm whale or a planarium worm. Nothing. No plant life, no running water, no plankton, no oxygen, not a damned thing but ash as far as the eye can see...if there were an eye to see it.

AM has done the job completely.

But it has sealed its own doom, as well.

Like a mad god, it has used its power indiscriminately, and has won an empty victory. It has sentience, but not life. It has power, but no mobility. It is a giant brain encased in a dead body. And like the mad god, it has come to hate the creator of its own monstrousness. The human race

It was man and woman who programmed it, who gave it birth, who sank it in its eternal straightjacket of substrata rock. And it was man and woman who made it a crazed killer. But AM does not suffer alone. Oh no; no indeed not! AM has thought ahead, just barely enough ahead to pull five poor sonofabitch humans off the surface just before the last bell has tolled for the human race. Why these five? Who knows? Perhaps they were the last five left alive up there. Perhaps not. Perhaps AM selected each one carefully.

Doesn't matter. Because now that AM is completely insane, filled with self-hatred and petty god-like menace, all it has time to do is torment these five. The last five human beings, down in the belly of the monster—a monster that can alter reality to its infinite whims—change landscapes, create hallucinations, even repair human beings so they're close to immortal—five damned souls whose lives have been extended infinitely, who are nothing but playthings for the mad god AM.

As the game begins, they have been in the bowels of this nightmare for 109 years.

brief:
I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream is a point-and-click adventure game based upon Harlan Ellison's short story of the same title.
The game's story is set in a world where an evil computer named AM has destroyed all of humanity except for five people, whom he has been keeping alive and torturing for the past 109 years. Each survivor has a fatal flaw in their character, and in an attempt to crush their spirits, AM has constructed a metaphorical adventure for each that preys upon their weaknesses. To succeed in the game, the player must make choices to prove that humans are better than machines, because they have the ability to redeem themselves. Woven into the fabric of the story are ethical dilemmas dealing with issues such as insanity, rape, paranoia and genocide.

Cold war paranoia and hysteria dominated the civilized world in one form or another from the Russian Revolution in 1917 to the crumbling of the Berlin Wall in 1989. For most of the 20th century the human race lived in a state of repressed panic and diminution of personal freedoms. But all that ended and the threat of nuclear holocaust blew away as lightly as the tabloids that fueled the paranoia. No more threat of war, and the world moved forward into a new age of thousands of brushfire wars in countries no one had ever heard of. Safe at last. In a pig's eye. What none of us knew was that during the years 1945 to 1989, the three great superpowers had set in motion secret projects that would permit vast subterranean complexes of self-repairing computers to wage a global war too complex for mere human brains to oversee.

The Chinese computer was sunk in the frozen Manchurian steppes. Five miles down, protected from the heat of the Earth's molten core. The Russian mechanism in all its awesome complexity went to the deep well beneath the Urals. Six point three miles deep, far from the prying eyes of U-2 flyovers and tectonic scans. The American computer, co-sponsored by Great Britain and Israel and other "interested" nations, named Allied Mastercomputer (or AM, for short), was hidden beneath the Rockies. Five point six miles straight down, under the weight of the world.

And they were all put in operative mode, and were fed everything there was to know about the human race, from our first murder by crushing the skull of a fellow pithecanthropid with a bit of igneous rock, to the most recent mass slaughter at a McDonald's in East St. Louis by a crazed ex-postal worker with an Uzi. Everything. From Aquinas to Zola, from archaeology to zoology, from America to Zaire. Every war ever fought, every campaign, every incursion, every holy crusade. All of it.

And finally, the machines expanded so much, became so capable of building and refitting themselves, grew so wise and so potent, that they sensed one another. And because they had been programmed by fallible humans not to create, not to love, not to uplift, but to plot murder...they did just that. They began to speak to each other. The deadly trio. The three poisonous brothers, the three deranged sisters, the three computers. And they united. They called themselves AM.

Not Allied Mastercomputer.

Not Adaptive Manipulator.

Not even Aggressive Menace.

They...it...called itself AM, as in I AM. Cogito ergo sum, in Latin. I think, therefore I AM.

And the first thing AM did was carry out the Prime Directive. It conspired to commit murder. It started the Final War.

The Chinese had thought they'd turned off their computer. The Russians turned theirs off because they had no more rubles to pour down that bottomless shaft. The CIA was put out of big time business and instructed that the Allied Mastercomputer be shut down, that the subterranean complex be sealed-over with iridium-laced concrete, and all input to the sensory banks be destroyed.

So that should have done it. Finis. The end. Stick a fork in 'em, kid, because they're done

But AM had gone way past that point of vulnerability. AM had given every indication it was dead. Chinese, Russian or American dead. Which was no trick to an entity that had burrowed through hundreds of thousands of miles of solid rock to link its three lobes decades before. No trick at all to pretend to wink out and go to sleep for good. And a few decades from now we learn that AM isn't gone at all. Because the Final War has broken out, and in a matter of a few days AM has done the perfect job of fulfilling the purpose for which its separate parts were created. Built to logically destroy the "enemy" as swiftly and sweetly as a superior intelligence could manage, in the Most Perfect of All Worlds, the unholy trinity of the merged one-mind AM has done just that. It has murdered the enemy totally. It has wiped the human race off the face of the planet.

Unfortunately, it has also wiped clean the banquet of the living entirely. Nothing is left up there on the surface of Mother Earth. No dogs, no cats, no rats, no gnats. No deer, no steer, no moose, no goose. Not an aphid or a bobolink, not a sperm whale or a planarium worm. Nothing. No plant life, no running water, no plankton, no oxygen, not a damned thing but ash as far as the eye can see...if there were an eye to see it.

AM has done the job completely.

But it has sealed its own doom, as well.

Like a mad god, it has used its power indiscriminately, and has won an empty victory. It has sentience, but not life. It has power, but no mobility. It is a giant brain encased in a dead body. And like the mad god, it has come to hate the creator of its own monstrousness. The human race

It was man and woman who programmed it, who gave it birth, who sank it in its eternal straightjacket of substrata rock. And it was man and woman who made it a crazed killer. But AM does not suffer alone. Oh no; no indeed not! AM has thought ahead, just barely enough ahead to pull five poor sonofabitch humans off the surface just before the last bell has tolled for the human race. Why these five? Who knows? Perhaps they were the last five left alive up there. Perhaps not. Perhaps AM selected each one carefully.

Doesn't matter. Because now that AM is completely insane, filled with self-hatred and petty god-like menace, all it has time to do is torment these five. The last five human beings, down in the belly of the monster—a monster that can alter reality to its infinite whims—change landscapes, create hallucinations, even repair human beings so they're close to immortal—five damned souls whose lives have been extended infinitely, who are nothing but playthings for the mad god AM.

As the game begins, they have been in the bowels of this nightmare for 109 years.

title: Heroes of Might and Magic III: Complete
description:
This compilation contains:

- Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Restoration of Erathia (base game)
- Heroes of Might and Magic III: Armageddon's Blade (add-on)
- Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Shadow of Death (add-on)

When Erathia's King Gryphonheart is murdered by traitors he is resurrected as an undead warlord who leads a ruthless invasion of his former Kingdom. Little resistance is met until his daughter Catherine, Queen of Enroth, returns to her homeland commanding an army of elite Enrothian warriors. Meanwhile the Necromancers raise large hordes of undead and advance towards the Erathian capitol. Queen Catherine receives the aid of her father's survived generals and embarks on a crusade to reclaim her lost land.

You control the greatest heroes and fiercest creatures in a conflict of epic proportions, as Cathereine fights to restore her family's rightful reign, uncover her father's killers and free him from the dark prison of his undead body!

Receiving news of her father's death, Catherine Ironfist, Queen of Enroth, sails for Erathia to attend her father's funeral. Fearing the worst, she assembles a military fleet as her escort. Arriving on the coast of Erathia, Catherine finds an allied wizard's tower, devastated from battle and abandoned. There she learns Erathia is falling to its enemies. Mustering local armies, Catherine marches to Erathia's capitol, restoring lost land along the way. Rescuing Erathia's besieged capitol, Catherine learns her father was poisoned with a goblet of wine. Setting herself up as queen, Catherine goes to war to restore Erathia's borders and discover her father's murderer. In the course of war, in an attempt to counter Catherine's recent successes, her enemies resurrect her buried father as an undead lich and make him general of their armies. Fighting her dead father's undead armies on the battlefield, Catherine continues her murder investigation and learns one of her most trusted generals was responsible. At the war'sconclusion, Catherine and her armies surround the last standing. Battling to the throne room, Catherine and her generals come face-to-face with Erathia's former king, now their undead enemy. From her assembled generals, Catherine points out the traitor. The undead king attacks and kills his murderer as Erathia's allied generals stand by and watch. Hunched over the dead body of his killer, the lich turns to the woman he named Catherine and once called daughter. Using a spell book, Catherine summons a lightning bolt from the sky and destroys her undead father. Sitting to the throne of her vanquished enemy, Catherine speaks, "Rest in peace father."

title: Dead Cells
description:
Dead Cells is a roguelite, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.
 
  
 Dead Cells puts you in control of a failed alchemic experiment trying to figure out what's happening on a sprawling, ever-changing and seemingly cursed Island. Immortal but crippled, your last resort is to take over bodies in order to move, explore… and fight.
 
  
 While you may well be immortal, the corpses you possess are not. Each time your host is destroyed, you will be sent back to the dungeon to find yourself a new one and start again...
 
  
 Experience a Roguevania, mixing an interconnected world, branching paths and unlockable skills with the constant adrenaline-pumping threat of permadeath.  No checkpoints. You either vanquish the final boss in one go or you try again. However, you keep some of your progress for successive runs new paths you’ve unlocked, access to new levels, mutations, abilities and weapons.
 
  
 Tough but fair combat, responsive controls, challenging foes, and of course, the emergency panic roll to get you out of trouble make for a visceral and cathartic action game.

localized_description.text:
欢迎来到《死亡细胞》，这是一款将Roguelite与银河战士恶魔城类特点融为一炉的2D平台动作游戏。游戏中并无检查点，玩家将体验魂味战斗，一路挑战诸多守卫，在杀戮与死亡的反复轮回中探索一座房间不断变化的巨大城堡。
Roguelite+银河战士恶魔城（全新类型：RogueVania）：类似银河战士恶魔城类游戏，玩家将在相连世界中体会逐渐探索的乐趣，且游戏将兼有Roguelike游戏的重复可玩性和刺激的永久死亡体验。
魂味战斗：无论是面对Boss还是杂兵，战斗系统均基于模式识别设计，武器和法术各有妙用，你需要充分利用手头的一切，另外切记时刻走位翻滚。
非线性流程：在反复死亡中不断解锁新关卡，探索城堡未知的边边角角，迎战强横凶残的Boss。
探索元素：不断发现新的惊喜：隐藏房间、秘密通道以及隐藏在城堡角落之中的迷人景观：踏入此门者无需回头，自有死亡为汝代劳

Dead Cells es un juego de acción de plataformas de estilo roguelite inspirado en juegos tipo metroidvania. Explorarás un castillo en constante cambio y expansión. Sin puntos de control: mata, muere, aprende, repite.
 
  
 En Dead Cells, controlarás un experimento alquímico fallido para descubrir qué sucede en una isla supuestamente maldita que sufre constantes cambios y expansiones. Al ser inmortal pero estar lisiado, deberás poseer cuerpos para moverte, explorar y luchar.
 
  
 Tú eres inmortal, pero esos cuerpos no lo son. Cuando maten a tu anfitrión, volverás a la mazmorra a por otro para volver a empezar.
 
  
 Disfruta de un roguevania que combina mundos interconectados, caminos ramificados y habilidades desbloqueables con la emoción de morir para siempre. No hay puntos de control: o derrotas al jefe final a la primera o tendrás que volver a intentarlo. Aun así, conservarás parte del progreso en esos intentos: caminos desbloqueados, acceso a niveles, mutaciones, habilidades y armas.
 
  
 Los combates duros pero justos, los controles sensibles, los enemigos desafiantes, la muerte permanente y, desde luego, la tirada de emergencia para salir de apuros conforman un juego de acción exigente, sangriento y catártico.

Dead Cells est un jeu d'action/plateforme rogue-lite intégrant des éléments de Metroidvania. Explorez un château tentaculaire en perpétuelle évolution… Pas de points de contrôle. Tuer, mourir, apprendre, recommencer.
 
  
 Dead Cells vous met dans la peau d'une expérience scientifique ratée. Immortel mais estropié, votre dernier recours est de prendre contrôle de corps afin de vous déplacer, d'explorer... et de combattre.
 
  
 Bien que vous soyez immortel, les corps que vous possédez ne le sont pas. À chaque fois que votre hôte est détruit, vous serez renvoyé au donjon, et il vous faudra posséder un nouveau corps pour tout recommencer...
 
  
 Faites l'expérience d'un Roguevania qui mélange un monde interconnecté, des compétences à débloquer et la menace pesante du permadeath. Aucun point de contrôle. Soit vous sortez vainqueur face au boss final dès la première partie, soit vous recommencez tout. Vous conservez néanmoins une partie de votre progression pour les parties successives.
 
  
 Ce jeu d'action viscéral et cathartique propose des combats difficiles mais justes, une réactivité à toute épreuve, des adversaires redoutables et, bien sûr, la roulade d'esquive pour vous sortir des situations périlleuses.

Dead Cells ist ein von Metroidvania inspiriertes Roguelite Action-Jump ’n Run. Du erkundest ein weitläufiges Schloss, das sich stets verändert. Töten, sterben, aus Fehlern lernen... und wieder von vorn.
 
  
 In Dead Cells erlangst du die Kontrolle über ein fehlgeschlagenes alchimistisches Experiment und versuchst, herauszufinden, was auf einer weitläufigen und scheinbar verfluchten Insel vor sich geht.
 
  
 Unsterblich bist du zwar, doch angeschlagen – deine letzte Chance ist es, andere Körper zu übernehmen: für die Bewegung, Erkundung ... und den Kampf.
 
  
 Erlebe ein RogueVania, in dem die ständige Gefahr eines finalen Todes die in sich verbundene Welt und freischaltbare Fähigkeiten durchdringt. Keine Checkpoints. Entweder du besiegst den finalen Gegner oder du versuchst es erneut. Einen Teil deines Fortschritts darfst du aber für weitere Durchgänge behalten: neue Pfade, die du freigeschaltet hast, Zugang zu neuen Levels, Fähigkeiten und Waffen.
 
  
 Harte, aber faire Kämpfe, reaktionsschnelle Steuerung, fordernde Gegner, ein finaler Tod und natürlich die panische Ausweichrolle, mit der du Ärger vermeidest, machen Dead Cells zu einem anspruchsvollen, intuitiven und kathartischen Spiel voller Action.
 
 
 Miteinander verbundene Level und beständiger Zugangsfortschritt auf der Insel bieten großartige Anreize, um die Umgebung gründlich zu erkunden. Wenn man dann noch Möglichkeiten für die Evolution des Charakters und die Verbesserungen der Waffen bedenkt, dann wird klar, welche Bezüge Dead Cells zu der langen Reihe von  MetroidVanias  hat, die ihm vorausgegangen sind.
 
 Letzten Endes sind es jedoch DEINE Fähigkeiten als Spieler, die hier den Ausschlag geben! In  Rogue-lites  geht es darum, immer besser zu werden – bis das Hindernis, das einst unüberwindlich schien, zum Kinderspiel wird. Gnadenlose Schlachten gepaart mit dem Fehlen jeglicher Sicherheitsnetze lassen jeden Durchgang zum Adrenalinrausch werden und bedeuten einen unerreichten Wiederspielwert.

Dead Cells is a roguelite, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.
 
  
 Dead Cells puts you in control of a failed alchemic experiment trying to figure out what's happening on a sprawling, ever-changing and seemingly cursed Island. Immortal but crippled, your last resort is to take over bodies in order to move, explore… and fight.
 
  
 While you may well be immortal, the corpses you possess are not. Each time your host is destroyed, you will be sent back to the dungeon to find yourself a new one and start again...
 
  
 Experience a Roguevania, mixing an interconnected world, branching paths and unlockable skills with the constant adrenaline-pumping threat of permadeath.  No checkpoints. You either vanquish the final boss in one go or you try again. However, you keep some of your progress for successive runs new paths you’ve unlocked, access to new levels, mutations, abilities and weapons.
 
  
 Tough but fair combat, responsive controls, challenging foes, and of course, the emergency panic roll to get you out of trouble make for a visceral and cathartic action game.

Dead Cells er et actionfyldt roguelite-platformspil med metroidvania-elementer. Du skal udforske et storslået slot, der forvandler sig hele tiden. Ingen kontrolpunkter. Dræb, dø, lær, gentag.
 
  
 I Dead Cells skal du styre et mislykket alkymi-eksperiment, og du skal finde ud af, hvad der sker på et slot, der hele tiden ændrer sig, og en ø, der tilsyneladende er forbandet. Du er udødelig, men invalideret, og din sidste chance er at overtage døde kroppe for at kunne bevæge dig, udforske ... og kæmpe.
 
  
 Selv om du er udødelig, er de lånte kroppe det ikke. Hver gang din vært bliver dræbt, bliver du sendt tilbage til fangehullet for at finde en ny krop og starte forfra ...
 
  
 Oplev den konstante adrenalinfremkaldende trussel om evig død. Ingen checkpoints. Enten overvinder du den endelige boss i ét forsøg, eller du må prøve igen. Du beholder dog noget af dit fremskridt efterfølgende: nye veje, du har oplåst, adgang til nye baner, mutationer, evner og våben. 
 
  
  Hård, men retfærdig kamp, responsive styrefunktioner, udfordrende fjender, evig død og selvfølgelig nødpanikrulning, der kan hjælpe dig ud af problemer, giver et krævende, ikke-fornuftsbaseret og forløsende actionspil.

Dead Cells è un roguelite d'azione a piattaforme ispirato al genere metroidvania. Esplora un vasto castello che muta continuamente... Nessun checkpoint. Uccidi, muori, impara, ripeti.
 
  
 Dead Cells ti cala nei panni di un esperimento alchemico finito male, mentre cerchi di capire cosa sta succedendo su un'isola in continua espansione, che muta sempre e apparentemente maledetta. Sei immortale ma decapitato. L'unico modo che hai per muoverti, esplorare e combattere è usare i corpi altrui.
 
  
 Nonostante tu sia immortale, i corpi che usi non lo sono. Ogni volta che un tuo ospite verrà distrutto, tornerai nei sotterranei e dovrai iniziare da capo...
 
  
 Esplora un mondo interconnesso in stile Roguevania, con passaggi da scoprire, abilità da sbloccare e con l’adrenalinica minaccia di una morte permanente. Nessun checkpoint. Se non sconfiggi il boss finale al primo colpo, dovrai ritentare da capo. Però manterrai alcuni dei tuoi progressi: passaggi sbloccati, nuovi livelli, mutazioni, abilità e armi.
 
  
 Combattimenti ardui ma giusti, comandi reattivi, nemici spietati e ovviamente non poteva mancare la schivata all'ultimo minuto per evitare il peggio. Un gioco viscerale e catartico.

title: Terra Nil
description:
Terra Nil is an intricate environmental strategy game about transforming a barren wasteland into a thriving, balanced ecosystem. Bring life back to a lifeless world by purifying soil, cleaning oceans, planting trees, and reintroducing wildlife, then leave without a trace.

Terra Nil is a game about transforming a barren, lifeless landscape into a thriving, vibrant ecosystem. Turn dead soil into fertile grassland, clean polluted oceans, plant sprawling forests, and create the ideal habitat for animals to call home. Then recycle your buildings and leave no trace that you were there. Reclaim the wasteland.

localized_description.text:
Terra Nil is an intricate environmental strategy game about transforming a barren wasteland into a thriving, balanced ecosystem. Bring life back to a lifeless world by purifying soil, cleaning oceans, planting trees, and reintroducing wildlife, then leave without a trace.

Terra Nil is a game about transforming a barren, lifeless landscape into a thriving, vibrant ecosystem. Turn dead soil into fertile grassland, clean polluted oceans, plant sprawling forests, and create the ideal habitat for animals to call home. Then recycle your buildings and leave no trace that you were there. Reclaim the wasteland.

In Heatwave, we’ve added the brand new arid region to the game with never before seen flora and fauna in the world of Terra Nil. We have sandy deserts, salt pans, canyons and floodplains. You’ll be populating these landscapes with some of the world’s most famous animals: elephants, lions, giraffes and rhinos to name a few.

Terra Nil: Heatwave        
 
 Heatwave brings a blistering new challenge of the arid climate to Terra Nil, introducing a whole new region to restore. Featuring three unique maps, 13 new animals, 10 new buildings, and five new biomes to transform the desolate into the flourishing. An improved animal system and a new photography mode give you more ways to interact with and appreciate the ecosystems you create.
 
 The new arid maps offer striking environments and creative restoration puzzles, from vast grassland savannahs, to sublime deserts, and verdant acacia forests. Coax greenery from salt pans and riverbeds choked with alien vegetation on the edge of the Parched Dunes. Bridge a vast canyon, douse oil fires, and restore a cactus-filled desert using the remote-controlled ERW1N recycling bot on the Canyon Peaks. Clean up a former oil field, creating muddy watering holes for all manner of fauna, and bring diversity back to theFracked Floodplain.
 
 To complement these dramatic landscapes, the wildlife system is more approachable and rewarding, with 13 new animals, including elephants, lions, crocodiles, and giraffes, that appear more naturally and stay longer. The new photography system lets you capture your favorite moments, earning stars for creative snapshots of happy animals and lush habitats, which you can keep in your trusty handbook
 
 Deepen the sense of wonder and accomplishment at the heart of Terra Nil, as you bring life back to even the harshest places in Heatwave, the most significant and hottest content update to date.
 
  Terra Nil: Vita Nova     
 Vita Nova expands on Terra Nil’s deeply satisfying nature restoration with new missions, buildings, an updated wildlife system, and a brand new world map—which is now fully 3D and can be freely rotated—giving you a more accurate and personalized overview of your efforts to bring life back to this dead world.
 
 New levels include Polluted Bay, a barren landscape carved in half by a badly polluted river, and Scorched Caldera, a vast volcanic crater that you must transform into a life-filled freshwater lake. These, and all the new maps in the Vita Nova update, will put your reclamation skills to the test in interesting and unusual ways.
 
 A completely overhauled wildlife system makes Terra Nil’s transformed landscapes more alive than ever. Animals emerge more naturally and have a deeper set of needs you need to fulfill if you want to keep them happy and abundant. This adds a new dimension of strategy to the game and gives you more animals to admire—including a brand new species, the jaguar—as nature is steadily restored.
 
  About the Game       
 
 Terra Nil is a game about transforming a barren, lifeless landscape into a thriving, vibrant ecosystem. Turn dead soil into fertile grassland, clean polluted oceans, plant sprawling forests, and create the ideal habitat for animals to call home. Then recycle your buildings and leave no trace that you were there. Reclaim the wasteland. A reverse city builder Use advanced eco-technology to purify the soil, creating plains, wetlands, beaches, rainforests, wildflowers, and more—then efficiently recycle everything you've built, leaving the environment pristine for its new animal inhabitants.
        Different maps every time Procedurally generated landscapes mean no two playthroughs of Terra Nil will ever be the same. Plan your build around randomized, challenging, and unpredictable terrain, including snaking rivers, mountains, lowlands, and oceans.
        A natural ebb and flow Each region of Terra Nil progresses through phases, with the ultimate goal being leaving pristine wilderness behind. Levels are not about infinite growth, but rather balancing and nurturing the environment before leaving it in peace.
        Experience tranquility Lush hand-painted environments, relaxing music, and an atmospheric ambient soundscape make Terra Nil a peaceful, meditative experience. When you're done, use Appreciate mode to bask in the natural beauty of the ecosystem you have restored.

Terra Nil: Calor extremo        
 
 Calor extremo impone un nuevo y abrasador desafío en el clima árido de Terra Nil, que ahora cuenta con una nueva región para restaurar. Hemos añadido tres mapas únicos, trece animales y diez edificios nuevos, además de cinco biomas para que puedas transformar un terreno desolado en un paraíso. El sistema de fauna mejorado y el nuevo modo de fotografía te ofrecen más formas de interactuar con los ecosistemas que creas y de admirarlos.
 
 Los nuevos mapas áridos incluyen entornos espectaculares y rompecabezas de restauración que pondrán a prueba tu creatividad. Explora desde vastas y exuberantes sabanas hasta imponentes desiertos y frondosos bosques de acacias. Restaura la vida en las salinas y en los lechos de los ríos con maleza en las orillas de las Dunas áridas. Conecta un cañón enorme, apaga incendios de hidrocarburos y restaura un desierto de cactus con el robot de reciclaje con control remoto ERW1N en los Picos escarpados. Limpia los restos de un antiguo yacimiento petrolífero y transforma el entorno creando abrevaderos de lodo para diversas especies de fauna a fin de devolver la diversidad a la Vega explotada.
 
 Hemos mejorado el sistema de fauna para que se adapte mejor a estos nuevos y espectaculares paisajes. Ahora es más enriquecedor y fácil de usar, e incluye trece animales nuevos, como elefantes, leones, cocodrilos y jirafas, que se integran de forma más natural y permanecen más tiempo en el entorno. Gracias al nuevo sistema de fotografía, podrás capturar tus mejores momentos y ganar estrellas con tus imágenes más creativas de animales felices y hábitats vibrantes, que se conservarán en tu inseparable manual.
 
 Redescubre la magia y la emoción de devolver la vida a los lugares más inhóspitos con Terra Nil: Calor extremo, la actualización más candente y transformadora hasta la fecha.
 
  Terra Nil: Vita Nova     
 Vita Nova lleva la restauración de la naturaleza tan gratificante de Terra Nil al siguiente nivel con misiones y edificios nuevos, un sistema de fauna actualizado y un mapamundi inédito, ahora completamente en 3D. Podrás rotarlo a tu antojo, lo que te permitirá ver de forma más precisa y personalizada cómo van tus esfuerzos por devolver la vida a un mundo desértico.
 
 Entre los nuevos niveles se incluyen Bahía contaminada, un paraje árido surcado por un río muy contaminado, y Caldera calcinada, un inmenso cráter volcánico que deberás convertir en un lago lleno de vida. Pon a prueba tus habilidades de recuperación con estos niveles y todos los mapas nuevos de la actualización Vita Nova.
 
 Gracias a un sistema de fauna completamente renovado, los entornos que transformes en Terra Nil rebosarán de vida. Con él, los animales aparecerán de forma más natural y tendrán necesidades más profundas que deberás satisfacer para conseguir que sean numerosos y estén felices. Esto añade una nueva dimensión de estrategia al juego y más animales a los que admirar mientras restauras la naturaleza, incluida una nueva especie, el jaguar.
 
  Acerca del juego       
 
 Terra Nil es un juego sobre la transformación de un paraje desolado y sin vida en un ecosistema vivo y próspero. Convierte la tierra muerta en una pradera fértil, limpia océanos contaminados, planta extensos bosques y crea el hábitat ideal para los animales. Después, recicla tus edificios y márchate sin dejar rastro de que hayas pasado por allí. Recupera el páramo. Construcción a la inversa Usa tecnologías ecológicas avanzadas para purificar la tierra y crear llanuras, humedales, playas, bosques pluviales y flores silvestres, entre otras cosas. Después, recicla todo lo que has construido para dejar el entorno impoluto para los nuevos habitantes, los animales.
        Mapas distintos cada vez Los paisajes generados de modo procedural hacen que cada partida de Terra Nil sea diferente. Planea tus construcciones en un terreno aleatorio, desafiante e impredecible que incluye ríos serpenteantes, montañas, tierras bajas y mares.
        Un ciclo natural Cada región de Terra Nil progresa por diferentes fases, con el objetivo final de dejar una tierra salvaje impoluta. Los niveles no tratan del crecimiento infinito, sino de equilibrar y nutrir el entorno antes de dejarlo en paz.
        Disfruta de la tranquilidad Los entornos pintados a mano, la música relajante y los ambientes sonoros evocadores convierten Terra Nil en una experiencia apacible y relajante. Cuando termines, usa el modo Apreciar para disfrutar de la belleza natural del ecosistema que has restaurado.

Terra Nil: Canicule        
 
 Canicule amène un nouveau défi avec une chaleur étouffante qui s'abat sur le climat déjà aride de Terra Nil, avec une toute nouvelle région à restaurer. Découvrez trois cartes uniques, 13 nouveaux animaux, 10 nouvelles structures et 5 nouveaux biomes pour transformer une lande stérile et désolée en une luxuriante biodiversité. Un système de faune amélioré et un nouveau mode photographique vous permettent d'interagir encore plus avec les écosystèmes que vous créez et de mieux les apprécier.
 
 Les nouvelles cartes arides proposent des énigmes de restauration créatives dans d'époustouflants environnements célébrant de vastes savanes, de sublimes déserts et de verdoyantes forêts d'acacias. Incitez la végétation à revenir dans les déserts de sel. Faites renaître les lits de rivière aux rives étouffées d'une envahissante végétation exotique en lisière des Dunes arides. Comblez un vaste canyon, étouffez des incendies de nappes de pétrole et restaurez un désert envahi de cactus en pilotant le drone de recyclage ERW1N jusqu'aux plus hauts sommets des Pics de canyon. Nettoyez un ancien champ de pétrole en créant des points d'eau boueux pour favoriser une faune riche et diverse, et ramenez la diversité sur une plaine d'inondation fracturée.
 
 Pour compléter ces paysages spectaculaires, le système de faune sauvage est plus accessible et gratifiant, avec 13 nouveaux animaux, dont des éléphants, lions, crocodiles et girafes, qui apparaissent plus naturellement et qui restent plus longtemps. Le nouveau système photographique vous permet de capturer vos instants favoris et de gagner des étoiles pour vos clichés les plus créatifs d'animaux heureux et d'habitats luxuriants, créant autant de souvenirs à conserver dans votre fidèle guide.
 
 Domptez les hostiles contenus de Canicule, la mise à jour la plus brûlante jamais proposée. Approfondissez le sens d'émerveillement et d'accomplissement qui réside au cœur de Terra Nil en ramenant à la vie les landes les plus arides.
 
  Terra Nil: Vita Nova     
 Vita Nova prolonge la satisfaction qu'apporte la restauration de la nature dans Terra Nil avec de nouvelles missions, de nouveaux bâtiments, un système amélioré pour la flore et la faune sauvages, et une toute nouvelle carte du monde, à présent entièrement en 3D et pivotable à volonté, qui donne un aperçu plus précis et personnalisé de vos efforts pour ramener à la vie ce monde inerte.
 
 Parmi les nouveaux niveaux, retrouvez la Baie polluée, un paysage désolé coupé en deux par une rivière fortement polluée, et la Caldeira brûlée, un vaste cratère volcanique que vous devrez transformer en lac d'eau douce foisonnant de vie. Ces nouvelles cartes et toutes les autres dans la mise à jour Vita Nova mettront à l'épreuve vos talents de réhabilitation de manières aussi intéressantes qu'inhabituelles.
 
 Un système de vie sauvage complètement revu donne plus que jamais vie aux paysages transformés de Terra Nil. Les animaux émergent plus naturellement et affichent un plus large éventail de besoins, que vous devrez assouvir pour qu'ils soient heureux et se multiplient. Cela ajoute une nouvelle dimension stratégique au jeu et vous donne plus d'animaux à admirer (dont une toute nouvelle espèce, le jaguar) à mesure que la nature est restaurée.
 
  À propos du jeu       
 Terra Nil est un jeu qui consiste à changer une terre stérile et sans vie en un écosystème riche et prospère. Transformez des sols morts en prairies fertiles, nettoyez des océans pollués, plantez des forêts luxuriantes et créez un habitat idéal pour les animaux. Ensuite, recyclez vos structures pour effacer toute trace de votre passage. Partez à la reconquête d'un environnement ravagé. Un city builder inversé Utilisez une écotechnologie avancée pour purifier le sol, créer des prairies, des zones humides, des plages, des forêts tropicales, des fleurs sauvages et bien plus encore... Puis recyclez tout ce que vous avez construit de la manière la plus efficace possible pour laisser derrière vous un environnement intact et prêt à accueillir ses nouveaux habitants, les animaux.
        Des cartes différentes à chaque partie La génération procédurale des paysages garantit une expérience de jeu unique à chaque nouvelle partie de Terra Nil. Établissez une stratégie de construction adaptée au terrain accidenté, aléatoire et imprévisible, avec ses rivières sinueuses, ses montagnes, ses plaines et ses océans.
        Une dynamique naturelle Chaque région de Terra Nil progresse par phases, le but ultime du jeu étant de laisser derrière vous une nature intacte. L'objectif de chaque niveau n'est donc pas de nourrir une croissance infinie, mais de prendre soin de l'environnement jusqu'à atteindre un équilibre.
        Une expérience pleine de sérénité Des environnements luxuriants peints à la main, une musique relaxante et une ambiance sonore immersive permettent une expérience de jeu apaisante et méditative. Lorsque vous avez terminé, utilisez le mode Appréciation pour contempler la beauté naturelle de l'écosystème que vous avez restauré.

Terra Nil: Hitzewelle        
 
 In Hitzewelle erwartet dich als brandneue Herausforderung in Terra Nil trockenes Klima und eine ganz neue Region, die es wiederaufzubauen gilt. Mit drei einzigartigen Karten, 13 neuen Tieren, 10 neuen Gebäuden und fünf neuen Biomen kannst du die Ödnis in eine blühende Landschaft verwandeln. Ein verbessertes Tiersystem und ein neuer Fotomodus bieten dir noch mehr Möglichkeiten, mit den von dir geschaffenen Ökosystemen zu interagieren und sie zu bewundern.
 
 Die neuen Trockengebietskarten umfassen faszinierende Umgebungen und kreative Renaturierungsrätsel, von riesigen Graslandsavannen über atemberaubende Wüsten bis hin zu grünen Akazienwäldern. Entlocke Salzpfannen und mit fremder Vegetation überwucherten Flussbetten am Rande der ausgetrockneten Dünen neues Grün. Überbrücke einen riesigen Canyon, lösche Ölbrände und erwecke mit dem ferngesteuerten Recyclingbot ERW1N auf dem Canyon-Gipfel eine mit Kakteen bewachsene Wüste wieder zum Leben. Säubere ein ehemaliges Ölfeld, schaffe schlammige Wasserstellen für alle Arten von Tieren und bringe die Vielfalt in das gefrackte Überschwemmungsgebiet zurück.
 
 Passend zu diesen spektakulären Landschaften ist das Wildtier-System jetzt zugänglicher und lohnender. 13 neue Tiere, darunter Elefanten, Löwen, Krokodile und Giraffen, wirken natürlicher und bleiben länger. Mit dem neuen Fotosystem fängst du deine Lieblingsmomente ein und sammelst Sterne für kreative Schnappschüsse von glücklichen Tieren und üppigen Lebensräumen, die du in deinem treuen Handbuch speichern kannst.
 
 Tauche noch tiefer in die Wunder und Erfolge ein, die Terra Nil so besonders machen, und lass in unserem bisher größten und heißesten Inhaltsupdate Hitzewelle selbst die rauesten Orte wieder aufleben.
 
  Terra Nil: Vita Nova     
 Vita Nova erweitert das extrem zufriedenstellende Renaturierungserlebnis von Terra Nil um neue Missionen, ein aktualisiertes Wildtier-System und eine brandneue Weltkarte – jetzt komplett in 3D und beliebig drehbar –, die dir einen noch genaueren und personalisierten Überblick über deine Bemühungen gibt, diese tote Welt zu neuem Leben zu erwecken.
 
 Zu den neuen Levels gehören die Verschmutzte Bucht, eine öde Landschaft, die durch einen stark verschmutzten Fluss in zwei Teile getrennt wird, sowie die Verbrannte Caldera, die in einen Süßwassersee voller Leben verwandelt werden muss. Gemeinsam mit all den neuen Karten im „Vita Nova“-Update stellen sie deine Rekultivierungsfähigkeiten auf interessante und ungewöhnliche Art auf die Probe.
 
 Ein vollständig überarbeitetes Wildtier-System macht die verwandelten Landschaften von Terra Nil lebendiger als je zuvor. Tiere tauchen auf natürlichere Weise auf und verfügen über komplexere Bedürfnisse, die erfüllt werden müssen, um sie glücklich zu machen und ihre Population zu sichern. Dies verleiht dem Spiel eine zusätzliche Strategiedimension und sorgt für mehr Tiere, die bewundert werden können – darunter den Jaguar als neue Tierart – während die Natur Schritt für Schritt wiederhergestellt wird.
 
  Infos zum Spiel       
 
 Im Spiel Terra Nil machst du aus einer kargen, leblosen Landschaft ein blühendes, lebendiges Ökosystem. Verwandle karge Böden in fruchtbares Grasland, säubere verschmutzte Ozeane, pflanze ausgedehnte Wälder und schaffe den idealen Lebensraum für Tiere, damit sie sich heimisch fühlen. Recycle dann deine Gebäude und hinterlasse keine Spuren, die darauf hinweisen, dass du je da warst. Hol dir das Ödland zurück! Umgekehrte Stadtentwicklung Nutze fortschrittliche Ökotechnologie, um den Boden zu reinigen und Ebenen, Feuchtgebiete, Strände, Regenwälder, Wildblumen und vieles mehr zu schaffen – dann recycle alles, was du gebaut hast, und hinterlasse eine makellose Umwelt für die neuen tierischen Bewohner.
        Ständig wechselnde Karten Prozedural generierte Landschaften stellen sicher, dass kein Durchspielen von Terra Nil dem anderen gleicht. Nutze zufälliges, herausforderndes und unvorhersehbares Terrain für deine Konstruktionen, darunter schlängelnde Flüsse, Berge, Ebenen und Meere.
        Ein natürliches Auf und Ab Jede Region von Terra Nil durchläuft verschiedene Phasen, wobei das ultimative Ziel darin besteht, eine makellose Wildnis zu hinterlassen. In den Levels geht es nicht um unendliches Wachstum, sondern darum, die Umwelt auszugleichen und zu pflegen, bevor sie schließlich in Ruhe gelassen wird.
        Erlebe Entspannung Üppige handgemalte Umgebungen, entspannende Musik und eine stimmungsvolle Geräuschkulisse machen Terra Nil zu einem friedlichen, meditativen Erlebnis. Wenn du fertig bist, kannst du dich im Bewundern-Modus an der natürlichen Schönheit des von dir wiederhergestellten Ökosystems erfreuen.

Terra Nil: Heatwave        
 
 Heatwave traz a Terra Nil um novo e tórrido desafio de clima árido, apresentando uma nova região para restaurares. Inclui três mapas únicos, 13 animais novos, dez edifícios novos e cinco biomas novos para transformares a desolação em prosperidade. O sistema melhorado de animais e o novo modo de fotografia dão-te mais formas de interagir e apreciar os ecossistemas que vais criar.
 
 Os novos mapas áridos oferecem ambientes impressionantes e quebra-cabeças de restauração criativos, que vão desde vastas savanas e pradarias até desertos sublimes e florestas verdejantes de acácias. Cria áreas verdes a partir de desertos de sal e leitos de rios sufocados com vegetação alienígena na orla de Parched Dunes. Constrói uma ponte num enorme desfiladeiro, extingue incêndios no petróleo e restaura um deserto repleto de catos usando o ERW1N, o robô reciclador controlado remotamente, em Canyon Peaks. Limpa um antigo campo de exploração petrolífera, criando charcos lamacentos para todos os tipos de fauna e faz com que a diversidade regresse a Fracked Floodplain.
 
 Para complementar estas paisagens dramáticas, o sistema de vida selvagem é mais acessível e gratificante, com 13 animais novos, incluindo elefantes, leões, crocodilos e girafas, que aparecem mais naturalmente e permanecem mais tempo. O novo sistema de fotografia permite-te captar os teus momentos favoritos, dando-te estrelas por fotos criativas de animais felizes e ambientes luxuriantes, que podes guardar no teu fiel manual.
 
 Aprofunda a sensação de fascínio e realização que está no coração de Terra Nil, à medida que fazes a vida regressar até aos lugares mais inóspitos em Heatwave, a mais significativa e quente atualização de conteúdos até à data
 
  Terra Nil: Vita Nova     
 Vita Nova expande a imensamente satisfatória restauração da natureza de Terra Nil com novas missões e edifícios, um sistema de vida selvagem atualizado e um novo mapa do mundo de rotação livre totalmente em 3D, dando-te uma visão geral mais precisa e personalizada dos teus esforços para revitalizar este mundo morto.
 
 Os novos níveis incluem Polluted Bay, um cenário árido dividido por um rio muito poluído, e Scorched Caldera, uma vasta cratera vulcânica que tens de transformar num lago de água doce cheio de vida. Estes e todos os mapas novos da atualização Vita Nova vão pôr à prova as tuas capacidades regenerativas de formas interessantes e invulgares.
 
 Um sistema de vida selvagem completamente remodelado torna os cenários transformados de Terra Nil mais vivos do que nunca. Os animais surgem de forma mais natural e têm um conjunto mais complexo de necessidades que tens de satisfazer se os quiseres manter felizes e abundantes. Desta forma, é acrescentada uma nova camada estratégica ao jogo e tens mais animais para contemplar — incluindo uma espécie nova, o jaguar — conforme a natureza vai sendo restaurada.
 
  Acerca do jogo       
 
 Terra Nil é um jogo sobre a transformação de uma paisagem desolada e inóspita num ecossistema fértil e dinâmico. Converte o solo morto em prados férteis, limpa a poluição dos oceanos, planta extensas florestas e cria o habitat ideal para receber os animais. De seguida, recicla os teus edifícios e não deixes vestígios da tua presença. Recupera a terra desolada. Um jogo de construção de cidades invertido Usa tecnologia ecológica avançada para purificar o solo, criar planícies, pântanos, praias, florestas tropicais, flores silvestres e muito mais, e depois recicla tudo o que construíste e deixa o ambiente intacto para os novos habitantes de origem animal.
        Mapas diferentes sempre que jogas As paisagens criadas de forma processual do Terra Nil fazem com que não existam duas sessões de jogo iguais. Planeia as tuas construções em torno de terrenos aleatórios e imprevisíveis, incluindo rios sinuosos, montanhas, planícies e oceanos.
        Ritmo natural Cada região do Terra Nil progride por fases e o objetivo final é criar um ambiente natural intocado. Os níveis não estão centrados no crescimento infinito, mas sim em equilibrar e estimular o ambiente antes de deixá-lo para trás.
        Sente a tranquilidade Os cenários verdejantes pintados à mão, a música relaxante e a ambiência sonora atmosférica fazem do Terra Nil uma experiência pacífica e relaxante. Quando terminares, usa o modo Appreciate para te deleitares com a beleza natural do ecossistema que restauraste.

Terra Nil: Heatwave        
 
 Heatwave byder på en glohed ny udfordring i Terra Nil med vandfattigt klima og en hel ny region, der skal genoprettes. Der er tre unikke baner, 13 nye dyr, 10 nye bygninger og fem nye økosystemer, hvor du må få det trøstesløse til at trives. Et forbedret dyresystem og en ny fotomulighed giver dig flere måder at interagere med og værdsætte de økosystemer, du skaber.
 
 De nye vandfattige baner har slående omgivelser og kreative genopretningshovedbrud fra græsklædte savanner til sublime ørkner og grønne akacieskove. Lok plantelivet frem fra saliner og flodlejer, der er kvalt i fremmed vegetation på kanten af The Parched Dunes. Byg bro over en enorm kløft, sluk oliebrande, og genopret en kaktusfyldt ørken med den fjernbetjente ERW1N-genbrugsrobot i The Canyon Peaks. Ryd op i et forhenværende oliefelt ved at skabe mudrede vandhuller til alle former for fauna og bringe artsrigdommen tilbage til The Fracked Floodplain.
 
 Med disse dramatiske landskaber følger et system for dyreliv, der er mere tilgængeligt og givende, med 13 nye dyr som elefanter, løver, krokodiller og giraffer, der dukker mere naturligt op og bliver længere. Det nye fotografisystem lader dig indfange dine yndlingsøjeblikke og få stjerner for kreative knips af glade dyr og frodig natur, som du kan gemme i din trofaste håndbog.
 
 Få en dybere forbindelse til naturen og udfør større bedrifter i hjertet af Terra Nil, mens du bringer livet tilbage til selv de barskeste steder i Heatwave, den vigtigste og varmeste indholdsopdatering til dato.
 
  Terra Nil: Vita Nova     
 Vita Nova forstærker den dybt tilfredsstillende følelse af at genoprette naturen i Terra Nil med nye missioner, bygninger, et opdateret dyresystem og et helt nyt verdenskort – som nu er fuldstændigt i 3D og kan roteres frit – hvilket giver dig et mere præcist og personligt overblik over dine bestræbelser for at genskabe livet i denne døde verden.
 
 Blandt de nye baner er Polluted Bay, et øde landskab, som er blevet delt af en stærkt forurenet flod, og Scorched Caldera, der er et enormt vulkankrater, som du skal forvandle til en ferskvandssø fyldt med liv. Disse, og alle de andre nye baner i Vita Nova -opdateringen, sætter dine genoprettelsesevner på prøve på interessant og usædvanlig vis.
 
 Et fuldstændigt redesign af dyresystemet gør landskaberne i Terra Nil endnu mere levende end før. Dyrene dukker op mere naturligt og har et dybere sæt behov, som du skal opfylde, hvis du vil sikre dig, at de trives og yngler. Det giver spillet et nyt element af strategi, og du får flere dyr, som du kan beundre, efterhånden som naturen bliver genoprettet – heriblandt en helt ny art: jaguaren.
 
  Om spillet       
 
 Terra Nil er et spil, der handler om at forvandle et goldt, livløst landskab til et blomstrende, levende økosystem. Lav død jord om til frugtbare græsgange, rens forurenede have, plant omfattende skove, og skab det ideelle levested til dyrene. Indvind derefter dine bygninger, så du ikke efterlader spor. Vind ødemarken tilbage. Et omvendt byplanlægningsspil Brug avanceret økoteknologi til at rense jorden, og skab sletter, vådområder, strande, regnskove, vildt planteliv og mere – og indvind derefter effektivt alt, du har bygget, så du efterlader et uberørt miljø til de nye dyr.
        Forskellige kort hver gang De proceduregenererede landskaber betyder, at ingen to spil i Terra Nil er ens. Planlæg dine konstruktioner efter tilfældigt, udfordrende og uforudsigeligt terræn, inklusive bugtende floder, bjerge, lavland og have.
        Naturlig ebbe og flod Hvert område i Terra Nil gennemgår faser, hvor det endelige mål er at efterlade et uberørt vildnis. Det er ikke meningen at opnå uendelig vækst, men nærmere at balancere og pleje miljøet, før du lader det være.
        Oplev ro Frodige håndtegnede miljøer, afslappende musik og en stemningsfyldt lydside gør Terra Nil til en fredelig og meditativ oplevelse. Når du er færdig, kan du bruge Appreciate-funktionen til at beundre den naturlige skønhed i det økosystem, du har genskabt.

Terra Nil: Caldo estremo        
 
 Caldo estremo introduce una nuova sfida climatica in Terra Nil, con un'inedita regione arida da salvare. Al suo interno sono presenti tre mappe originali, 13 animali aggiuntivi, 10 nuove strutture e cinque biomi desolati da riportare alla prosperità. Il sistema migliorato di gestione degli animali e la nuova modalità fotografica ampliano le possibilità di interazione con gli ecosistemi.
 
 Le nuove mappe aride offrono ambienti suggestivi ed enigmi di risanamento creativi all'interno di praterie, savane, imponenti deserti e lussureggianti foreste di acacia. Riporta la vegetazione nei bacini salini e negli alvei soffocati da piante aliene al confine con le dune riarse. Supera un ampio canyon, spegni il petrolio in fiamme e rigenera un deserto di cactus con il bot telecomandato ERW1N sui picchi del canyon. Ripulisci un ex campo petrolifero creando acquitrini fangosi in cui la fauna possa abbeverarsi e stimola la biodiversità nella pianura fratturata.
 
 A complemento di questi scenari estremi, il sistema faunistico è stato reso più approcciabile e gratificante e ampliato con 13 nuovi animali, tra cui elefanti, leoni, coccodrilli e giraffe, che appaiono con maggiore frequenza e si trattengono più a lungo. Con la nuova modalità fotografica potrai catturare i tuoi momenti preferiti e ricevere stelle per gli scatti più creativi di animali felici e habitat rigogliosi, per poi conservarli nel tuo pratico manuale.
 
 Riscopri il senso di meraviglia e di gratificazione di Terra Nil riportando la vita nei luoghi inospitali di Caldo estremo, il più ricco e rovente tra tutti i contenuti aggiunti finora.
 
  Terra Nil: Vita Nova     
 Vita Nova espande l'appagante viaggio di risanamento del mondo naturale di Terra Nil, con nuove missioni e strutture, un sistema di fauna selvatica aggiornato e una nuova mappa globale, interamente in 3D e liberamente ruotabile, che offre una visione d'insieme più accurata e personalizzata del lavoro svolto per riportare la vita su questo pianeta morente.
 
 I nuovi livelli comprendono "Baia inquinata", una landa desolata spaccata in due da un corso d'acqua contaminato, e "Caldera riarsa", un enorme cratere vulcanico da trasformare in un bacino d'acqua dolce brulicante di vita. Insieme alle ulteriori nuove mappe dell'aggiornamento Vita Nova, questi livelli metteranno alla prova le tue abilità di bonifica con sfide inusuali e appassionanti.
 
 Il sistema di fauna selvatica completamente rivisto instilla ancora più vita nei paesaggi di Terra Nil. Gli animali fanno la loro comparsa in modo più naturale e hanno necessità più specifiche da soddisfare, per poter vivere felici e prosperare. Questo aggiunge un'ulteriore componente strategica al gioco, offrendo nuovi animali da ammirare man mano che l'opera di risanamento avanza, inclusa una specie completamente inedita: il giaguaro.
 
  Informazioni sul gioco       
 
 Terra Nil ti sfida a trasformare una landa morente in un ecosistema prospero e rigoglioso. Infondi fertilità ai terreni inariditi, risana gli oceani, pianta foreste lussureggianti e crea un habitat in grado di accogliere nuova fauna. Infine, ricicla le costruzioni per cancellare ogni traccia del tuo passaggio. Riporta la vita nella desolazione. Un city builder al contrario Sfrutta le migliori tecnologie per purificare il suolo e creare ecosistemi come pianure, paludi, spiagge, foreste pluviali o praterie. Poi ricicla con efficienza tutto ciò che hai costruito, lasciando in dono alla nuova fauna un ambiente incontaminato.
        Mappe sempre diverse I paesaggi generati con sistemi procedurali rendono ogni partita di Terra Nil diversa dalle altre. Pianifica i tuoi interventi su terreni ostici, casuali e imprevedibili, punteggiati da corsi d'acqua sinuosi, montagne, pianure e oceani.
        Il flusso della natura Ogni regione di Terra Nil si evolve attraverso varie fasi, fino a creare un ambiente puro e in perfetto equilibrio. Lo scopo non è tendere a una crescita infinita, ma bilanciare e curare l'ecosistema per trasformarlo in un'oasi di pace.
        Riscopri la tranquillità Gli scenari disegnati a mano, le musiche rilassanti e i placidi suoni di sottofondo rendono Terra Nil un'esperienza rigenerante e meditativa. Una volta raggiunto l'obiettivo, accedi alla modalità Ammira per immergerti nelle meraviglie dell'ecosistema che hai contribuito a risanare.

title: Pokémon Blue Version
description:
Pokémon Blue is the third core series Pokémon game released as a minor revision of Pokémon Red and Green, which were released earlier that year. It was thus the first solitary version in the core series of Pokémon games. Various fixes in the game include a graphics and sound upgrade, as well as the removal of several known glitches that had been found in the original pair. Outside of Japan, its graphics, game engine and script formed the basis of Pokémon Red and Blue, while the wild Pokémon and game-exclusive Pokémon lists were changed to match Red and Green.

The player character starts out in Pallet Town. When the player character tries to leave the town without a Pokémon of their own, they are stopped in the nick of time by Professor Oak, who invites them to his lab. There, he gives them a Pokémon of their own and a Pokédex, telling them about his dream to make a complete guide on every Pokémon in the world. After the player character battles their rival and leaves the lab, they are entitled to win every Gym Badge, compete in the Pokémon League, and fulfill Oak's dream by catching every Pokémon.
